    The push-down of grRep is the graded module #

    totToM intertwines the push-down action of the path algebra with the action of k(P) through linPres (totToM_pdAct). For a convex piece S containing all cover objects carrying M, it is an isomorphism of k(P)-modules from the push-down pdMod of grRep onto M (pdModEquiv).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.totToM_pdAct {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} (k : Type u) [Field k] {ℓ : (y : P) → vtx x₀ ⟶ vtx y} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) M] {μ : Graded.GrMod (rayGrAlg ℓ k) M} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (hS : ∀ (a : Cover x₀), W ℓ k μ a ≠ ⊥ → a ∈ S) (z : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k (RayQuiver.quiver P)) (x : (grRep ℓ k μ S).Tot) :
